notes.title: Explosive Content Update for Steel Assault! +[20% discount for a limited time]
notes.notes:
[b]Free Steel Assault Soundtrack[/b]

Good news everyone! We heard from the community, we read the reviews and since people dig the Steel Assault soundtrack so much, we decided to give it away for free! 
You get 18 powerful tracks mixing rock, chiptune and industrial music with an additional FM-synthesized remix album of all tracks. 


[b]Difficulty balancing[/b]

The developing team at Zenovia Interactive and Tribute Games have calibrated the difficulty and made precise adjustments to the base game of Steel Assault, more precisely its normal difficulty mode.

It’s important to understand that Steel Assault’s original game was designed around Hard Mode. The Previous Normal Mode was a less painful expression of the core game experience, bridging the gap between easy (for 1st time platformer players) and hard (for the true mastery of the genre). This original normal mode leaned too close to easy, a little too far from the authentic “retro hard” experience envisioned by Sri Kankanahalli the creator/designer of Steel Assault. 

[b]The hard and the arcade mode remain unaffected by this update.[/b] So all you platformer aficionados and speedruns can rest assured that your records remain valid.


[b]Modification list[/b]

*Restore damage to the levels of Hard and Arcade (i.e. x2 damage, keeping health restore between sub-stages, and additional health items

*Slight health increases on certains enemies and bosses (Flame Spider, Dragonfly Mech, Theta Hydron, Nanohazard, Server Wall…)

*Slight timing changes and respawn time  in certain enemies

We hope to get to see some of your speedruns and your no damage perfect runs! Don't hesitate to share them with us on our Discord server or social media.

The Steel Assault Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.379
notes.notes:
📡[incoming transmission from the RESISTANCE HQ]📡

We are bolstering the resistance with a bug fixing patch today! Dispatches coming in from our agents across the world with crucial feedback. We are blessed to have such an incredible community to help us! Note that we are closely evaluating core difficulty balancing changes. So be on the lookout for more news!

Patch notes below:

-Fix: glitch where Magnus Pierce sometimes disappears during the final boss fight. (What a coward!)
-Fix: visual bug where fences in Times Square sometimes turn black
-Fix: bug where Taro sometimes goes offscreen when exiting the Convergence Skybridge
-Fix: boss 2 glitch where Balthazar Kline's flashing bullets can be cancelled
-Fix: bugs when Taro uses the zipline in cutscenes
-Fix: stage 3 glitch where rain SFX occasionally keep playing when you go inside 
-Fix: bug where shield sometimes depletes even when the player has no control
-Fix: stage 1 miniboss bug where he didn't take damage from being punched up close
-Fix: bug where thorium mine's sparking cables sometimes don't hurt you
-Fix: bug where the Scorch Centipede's tail thrust effect appears mysteriously in the following stage
-Fix: bug where the Expert difficulty sometimes resets player health on stage 5
-Replaced SFX (slide recharge, match-up card zoom, white flash)
-Rebalanced Theta Hydron so that its right head is able to attack you on the right minigun
-Stage 3 Trident Bots spawns farther away from the player

[...end of transmission]

notes.title: New Patch for the Demo: Readability + Balance Update!
notes.notes:
Following the detailed and very welcomed feedback we got from players who've tried the demo so far, we decided to push a new patch for the demo. This patch only addresses [b][i]some[/i][/b] of the feedback we got. 

[h1]List of Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Backgrounds have been toned down in Sea Invasion, Times Square, and TS Helicopter sections
[*] All enemies take slightly longer to telegraph their attacks, and you have slightly more room for leeway dealing with them
[*] Visual distinction between cancellable and non-cancellable bullets: non-cancellable bullets flash between blue and orange
[*] Recharge time for "Slide" action is reduced slightly
[*] Jetpack soldiers stop before firing their attack
[*] Normal mode: Player no longer starts the stage on the minigun
[*] Minor bugfixes
[/list]

Here's a Before/After comparison image to show the new toned down background to improve visibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37998910/f6a84328154db66afc6b64f462a3f47226901f2e.png[/img]

[h1]ICYMI: Steel Assault Playable Demo[/h1]
In case you've missed our previous announcement, a first demo is now available for the post-apocalyptic 16-bit retro-style action platformer! Play the demo during this Steam Game Festival, ending soon! Get more information on the demo in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280300/view/3037083820204971636]our previous announcement[/url]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280300/Steel_Assault/

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
We would love to hear what your thoughts are on the improvements we've made so far. You can let the devs know what you think by posting on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1280300/discussions/]Steam Community Hub of Steel Assault[/url] or by chatting with the devs in the #steel-assault channel on the [url=http://discord.gg/tributegames]Tribute Discord[/url].  Of course we could not address all the feedback we got so far as there are things that require more time to change/fix/improve, but we hope you like what we've worked on so far!
